title: Synthetic Crystal Data Generation for Diffusion Pretraining in Material Property Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.22140v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion-based pretraining has emerged as a powerful strategy for learning transferable representations in graph neural networks for materials property prediction without requiring quantum-mechanical labels such as energies, forces, and stresses for every pretraining structure. However, the method retains a critical dependency: it requires structures residing near local minima of a potential energy surface, which have traditionally been obtained through costly DFT relaxations of known or physically synthesized compounds. This reliance constrains both the scale and the structural diversity of available pretraining data, leaving large regions of crystal structure space unexplored. In this work, we connect diffusion-based pretraining with synthetic structure generation to reduce this bottleneck. We introduce a synthetic data generation pipeline combining three complementary strategies: perturb-and-relax, generative sampling via MatterGen,

translated_title: 面向材料性质预测中扩散预训练的合成晶体数据生成
translated_abstract: 基于扩散的预训练已成为图神经网络中学习可迁移表示的有力策略，可用于材料性质预测，而无需为每个预训练结构提供诸如能量、力和应力等量子力学标签。然而，该方法仍存在一个关键依赖：它要求结构位于势能面的局部极小值附近，而这传统上需要通过对已知或物理合成的化合物进行昂贵的DFT弛豫来获得。这种依赖限制了可用预训练数据的规模和结构多样性，使得晶体结构空间的大量区域未被探索。在这项工作中，我们将基于扩散的预训练与合成结构生成相结合，以缓解这一瓶颈。我们提出了一个合成数据生成流水线，结合了三种互补策略：扰动-弛豫（perturb-and-relax）、通过MatterGen进行的生成式采样……
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合扰动-弛豫、MatterGen生成式采样等三种互补策略的合成晶体数据生成流水线，为材料性质预测的扩散预训练提供大规模且结构多样的弛豫结构，突破了依赖昂贵DFT弛豫获取预训练数据的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a synthetic crystal data generation pipeline combining three complementary strategies, including perturb-and-relax and generative sampling via MatterGen, to provide large-scale and structurally diverse relaxed structures for diffusion-based pretraining in material property prediction, alleviating the bottleneck of costly DFT relaxations.
